title: Workflow builder
idea: Workflow builder: A bounded workflow diagram pairs each selected step with a plain configuration panel and dependency explanation.
audience: People who need to configure workflow within a product-web surface.
worksWellWhen: Dependencies are easier to inspect spatially than in a flat list.
avoidWhen: An unrestricted canvas would obscure a short linear form.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic spatial layout through its configure workflow priority and explicit commitment contract: Validate references and test behavior before publishing an enabled workflow.
navigation: Workflow builder keeps the current configure workflow context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: A bounded workflow diagram pairs each selected step with a plain configuration panel and dependency explanation.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to configure workflow; dependencies are easier to inspect spatially than in a flat list.
composition.priority: Validate references and test behavior before publishing an enabled workflow.

imagery.role: Support the actual configure workflow context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Provide an ordered step list and non-drag insert/reorder controls.
Preserve entered data and focus when responsive panels become routes.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the workflow builder structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no configure workflow content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Validate references and test behavior before publishing an enabled workflow.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized configure workflow content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Validate references and test behavior before publishing an enabled workflow.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active configure workflow context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure task interaction latency with representative data and slow network states.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
